title: Vietnamese Jasmine Rice Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful rice bowl dish inspired by Vietnamese cuisine, featuring jasmine rice, grilled mi, and a variety of toppings.
instructions: Cook jasmine rice according to package instructions.
Grill or sauté mi according to preference.
In a small bowl, whisk together indulgent sauce and 1 tablespoon vegetable oil.
Add fluffy chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with sauce.
Heat remaining 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add cooked mi to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add cooked chicken, salt, and pepper to the pan, and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve mi and chicken mixture over cooked jasmine rice.
Garnish with Vietnamese cilantro, sliced scallions (if using), and a lime wedge.
